resources.string: Your computer can use this screen
Plug in the cable, or be on the same Wi-Fi: the computer’s screen appears here when you start it there.
On your computer, open Screenlet and choose “%1$s”.
Check that the computer shows the same code: %1$s
Pair only if the computer shows this same code, and confirm there too:
Tap to go back to it
Also after a restart. It only listens: next to no battery.
Off: the computer reaches this tablet only for 10 minutes after you open Screenlet.
To use it again, you will compare a code once more.
So the pairing code and the computer’s screen appear on their own, and the computer finds this tablet even with no Wi-Fi network, allow notifications, nearby devices and “Display over other apps”.
